tagline: 美能达胶片相机，1982 年发布
description: 美能达于1982年推出的胶片相机。配备35 mm f/2,8 (6 elements/6 groups)。快门速度Seikosha ESF between-the-lens shutter, 1/8–1/430 s, X-sync at 1/40 s. Electronic self-timer.。使用Thumb wheel advance, rewind crank.。感光度Manually set in 1/3 stops, 100–400 ISO on early copies, 100–1000 on later ones.。Active infrared autofocus, 0,9 m to infinity. Half-press to lock focus.。

specs.快门: Seikosha ESF between-the-lens shutter, 1/8–1/430 s, X-sync at 1/40 s. Electronic self-timer.
specs.对焦: Active infrared autofocus, 0,9 m to infinity. Half-press to lock focus.
specs.曝光测光: Programmed exposure from EV 6 (1/8 s, f/2,8) to EV 17 (1/430 s, f/17).
specs.感光度: Manually set in 1/3 stops, 100–400 ISO on early copies, 100–1000 on later ones.
specs.闪光灯: Dedicated clip-on flash, flashmatic exposure control.
specs.英文简介: The AF-C is a very nice and very good little camera.
